notes: Registered for ADR 0031 item 5: the size contrast at a held Qwen2.5 family, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct vs this model. Every field mirrors qwen2_5_7b_instruct except quantization. NOTE: 14.77B parameters is above the ~8B standing ceiling AND above ADR 0015's 1e10; Jahid raised default_max_params to 1.5e10 on 2026-09-14 to admit it (ADR 0031 item 4, PENDING SUPERVISOR CONFIRMATION), so run_decomposer.py loads this folder - if the supervisor reasserts 8B or 10B, this arm becomes out-of-scope. Measured from the upstream safetensors index (metadata fetched, weights not): 14,770,033,664 parameters, 1.5% under the raised ceiling. quantization 4bit NF4, for the same reason qwen3_5_9b uses it: bfloat16 weights are 29.54 GB and the box's RTX 3090 has 24 GiB, so this model CANNOT be loaded unquantized here. That means the 7B-vs-14B size contrast also moves precision (7B none, 14B 4bit); the alternative - running the 7B at 4bit too - would instead move precision in the Mistral-vs-Qwen family contrast, since mistral_7b_instruct runs unquantized (exp-004). Which confound to accept is Jahid's call, not this folder's; either arm can be forced with --quantization, and the resolved value is recorded in the run's metrics. WEIGHTS ARE NOT CACHED (~28 GB download). Fetch with, from the repo root: .venv/bin/python -c "from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download; print(snapshot_download('Qwen/Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct'))" - the .venv's hf/huggingface-cli entry point is broken (no click module), so the Python call is the working form. The id, revision cf98f3b3bbb457ad9e2bb7baf9a0125b6b88caa8, gated=false, and the 8 safetensors shards were verified against the hub API on 2026-09-14; config.json and model.safetensors.index.json are already in the cache from that check.
